name: 29121-deepdecode-8b-8gpu
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, all eight GPUs of one node. No GPU class is stated by the configuration, so absolute rates are not comparable with rates quoted for this configuration on other hardware.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1, one node, one in-process engine, no router and no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1024, bounded at 4096 requests / 3600 s safety, first 25% dropped as warmup by completion. The declared 10% cooldown does not fire, so the scored set is everything after the warmup: ~3072 requests, three full waves. streams=1024 equals `max-num-seqs`, so the running batch is 1024 with nothing queued behind it.
workload: `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt exactly 128 tokens and output exactly 2048, both min=max; the backend forces `ignore_eos` whenever max_tokens is set, so every request is one 128-token prefill and 2047 decode steps. `request_format: plain` submits raw `prompt_token_ids` with no chat template; temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0; seed static 29121. Prompts are Faker-generated synthetic English and prefix caching is off, so none is cacheable.
purpose: A long-form story generator on an eight-GPU node, serving 1024 concurrent users short prompts yielding 2048-token completions.
launch:
# The engine command line. Engine: commit 11857a00b0a59183286eab393df4e13b20efec3a
# (`git describe` = v0.11.1-122-g11857a00b0 -- a commit, not a release). The interpreter and the
# hardware seal are in configs/env.yaml, which is this machine's and is NOT portable.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
dtype: bfloat16
tensor-parallel-size: 8

# NOT DEFAULTS on the async serving path, whatever they look like: unpinned they fall through to
# 128 sequences / 2048 batched tokens, an eighth of the declared depth. Do not delete or raise.
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384

enable-prefix-caching: false
enable-chunked-prefill: true
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
